articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
articles.summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
articles.summary: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.

articles.title: US Treasury walks back crypto surveillance ‘travel rule’ proposal
articles.summary: The Treasury Department has withdrawn a controversial proposal that would have expanded requirements for cryptocurrency transactions.

articles.title: Trump administration moves closer to allowing crypto in 401(k) retirement plans
articles.summary: A rule that would open up 401(k) retirement accounts to alternative assets, including cryptocurrencies, has landed at the White House.

articles.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
articles.summary: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.

articles.title: Crypto ETFs see over half a billion dollars in outflows amid post-midterm market slide
articles.summary: U.S. spot crypto ETFs slumped back to net outflows on Thursday, with more than $540 million in withdrawals across major products.

articles.title: Nigeria’s central bank introduces stablecoin licensing rules, bans algorithmic versions
articles.summary: Nigeria's central bank issued new virtual asset regulations requiring stablecoin issuers and other service providers to obtain local licenses.

articles.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
articles.summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

articles.title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group
articles.summary: OFAC targeted offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives hide assets and dodge earlier sanctions.

articles.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
articles.summary: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds weren’t affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.

articles.title: Crypto Liquidations Top $1 Billion as Bitcoin Tests 11-Week Low
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell toward $75,500 after AI stocks plunged, and over $1 billion in the crypto derivatives market has been wiped out.

articles.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
articles.summary: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Crater
articles.summary: Thursday marked a massive reversal and historic selloff for AI stocks, and crypto was not immune. What held up the strongest?

articles.title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.5M in Crypto From 35 Investigations
articles.summary: Patrick Yaroch drained wallets using credentials the FBI had collected, then asked ChatGPT for advice on starting a new life in Europe.

articles.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.summary: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
articles.summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
articles.summary: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
articles.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.summary: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.summary: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

articles.title: Bitcoin erases post-election gains as Wall Street selloff triggers over $1 billion in crypto liquidations
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell 6% to $75,700 and ether 7% as a Nasdaq selloff hit crypto, triggering $1.03 billion in liquidations.

articles.title: Canary’s Injective ETF debuts on Nasdaq with exposure to staking rewards
articles.summary: Canary Capital's Staked INJ ETF debuts on Nasdaq, giving investors exposure to Injective's INJ token plus staking rewards reflected in NAV.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital seeks CFTC swap dealer registration for crypto options business
articles.summary: Anchorage Digital has applied for CFTC swap dealer registration and plans to offer European-style bitcoin and ether options if approved.

articles.title: Payward-affiliated fund and clients buy AAVE token stake on secondary market
articles.summary: Payward disclosed neither the size nor price of the AAVE purchases and said it may acquire more tokens.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
articles.summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

articles.title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
articles.summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

articles.title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
articles.summary: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.

articles.title: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report
articles.summary: Analysts said that the Clarity Act's path has become tougher, while advocacy group Stand With Crypto has endorsed 27 winning candidates so far.

articles.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
articles.summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
articles.summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?

articles.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
articles.summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

articles.title: Canadian Man Extradited to US Over Plot to Hijack University Supercomputers for Crypto
articles.summary: Prosecutors say Ryan Roach and a co-defendant targeted U.S. universities with supercomputers, stealing logins and secretly mining crypto.

articles.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
articles.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

articles.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
articles.summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.
